headline: Boeing (BA) Stock May Be Fully Priced Following Its 12% Slide
summary: Boeing stock has drifted lower over the past three years while the valuation checks send mixed signals, with a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) estimate pointing to a large gap versus the current share price and market multiples suggesting the stock is not obviously cheap. Boeing shares are down about 12.2% over the past three years, which means recent news flow and contract wins have not yet translated into strong shareholder returns.
